name: Lugaid mac Ítha
text: Lugaid mac Ítha is a constructed pedigree name. Its makers gave the hero of Munster, Lugaid mac Con, a father drawn from the invasion tradition, the Milesian figure Íth. The invented patronymic supplied genealogies with an illustrious forebear. Tradition also gives this Lugaid a wife, Fial. The families that became the O'Coffeys, the O'Driscolls, and other kindreds traced their line to the couple.

attributes.attribute: Genealogists invented the patronymic to attach Íth to Lugaid mac Con's line.
Tradition names Fial as his wife.
The O'Coffeys and O'Driscolls claimed descent from him.

okr.objective: Documents Lugaid mac Ítha as a constructed genealogical name for Lugaid mac Con built on Íth.
key_results: The name cites the Milesian Íth in the patronymic for use in genealogies.
It gives the Munster champion Lugaid mac Con an invented pedigree name.
The O'Coffeys, O'Driscolls, and other families traced their descent from him.
